package audit

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"example.test/auditapp/internal/domain"
	models "example.test/auditapp/internal/models/audit"
	rules "example.test/auditapp/internal/rules/audit"
	"example.test/auditapp/internal/scope"
)

// RecordAuthEvent appends one authentication event to the audit log of the
// verified tenant, attributed to the verified subject. Only the generated
// [auth.events] hook runs it; the event kind is the sole input.
func RecordAuthEvent(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	p RecordAuthEventPorts,
	in models.RecordAuthEventRequest,
) error {
	if !rules.ValidAuthEvent(in.Event) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: event", domain.ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"event": in.Event})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return p.Events.Append(ctx, e, models.NewEvent{
		Type:    "auth." + in.Event,
		Payload: payload,
	})
}
